Supervisor's note, Ward 4 — Anjali
Harish told me in April he wanted to pass the critical care certificate by the end of the year. I asked him to write it on the duty-room board and then break it down.
He set one module a month and two practice sets a week, done on his days off. Every Friday after handover we spent ten minutes on his chart. He ticked what he finished and circled what slipped, without scolding himself.
In August he was moved to nights for five weeks. His practice sets stopped. I expected him to give up. Instead he came to me on a Friday morning, tired but calm, and said, "I'll do one set a week till nights end, and push module six to October."
He passed in December. I have asked him to show the new trainees his chart.
